text:
Diego: Quick design sync  new idea: instead of a shelf or modal, what about a "spotlight bar" that lives under the header and can expand into a focused panel? Less intrusive than modal, more discoverable than chip-only rail. Thoughts?
Noor: I like "spotlight bar" name. It gives a clear affordance without feeling like a gate. We should keep a compact collapsed state for return users.
Casey: Research note  users like low-friction surfaces. Spotlight bar could show one highlighted starter with a small progress badge if they started it before. That badge ties to the quickstart checklist.
Mei: Accessibility checklist if we do this: aria-live announce once on first visit, a clear skip-link target, focusable expand control, and keyboard-close with Esc that returns focus. Also color contrast on the badge must meet AA.
Aria: Copy options for header: A) "Spotlight: Try a starter" B) "Get started with a sample" C) "Run a quick project" I prefer C for clarity. Microcopy: "Complete one to mark onboarding step as done."
Diego: Good. Casey can you prototype the progress badge states: not-started, in-progress, completed? We can show small checkmark and completion timestamp for analytics correlation.
Casey: Yep. Also propose we surface an inline checklist badge on the project list: small dot becomes green when sample completes. Implementation: lightweight, update via query param callback.
Noor: Technical approach: route param like `/projects/${id}?starter=vector-chat` keeps it stateless. When sample finishes we emit `onboard:sample_completed` event and mark checklist. Quick sketch:
```
<Link to={`/projects/${p.id}?starter=${sample.slug}`}>Run starter</Link>
// on completion -> analytics.emit('onboard:sample_completed', { sample: sample.slug })
```
Mei: For mobile: spotlight bar should collapse into an icon in the top nav to avoid eating vertical space. Expand into full-screen panel only when tapped. Must keep the same a11y behavior.
Aria: Analytics events we need: spotlight_shown, spotlight_expanded, starter_initiated, starter_completed, badge_viewed. I'll own the event naming + funnel.
Diego: UX variants to ship to eng: 1) compact spotlight (MVP, single highlighted starter + CTA), 2) multi-card spotlight (thumbnails), 3) collapsed chip rail for low density. We should A/B 1 vs 2 for new users.
Casey: Dev estimate: MVP ~2 dev days + a11y pass. Thumbnails add another day. Mobile polish + analytics + checklist hook adds another day.
Noor: A11y tasks for PR: 1) add skip-link and target, 2) aria-live only on first-render, 3) focus management on expand/close, 4) visible focus rings. I'll add these to the PR template.
Diego: Copy pick: "Run a quick project" header, subcopy "Complete one to mark onboarding done." CTA = "Run starter". Aria to own analytics and funnel. Casey to mock variant 1 & 2 in Figma. Noor to spike on route param flow and checklist badge.
onboard-bot: Handoff reminder  attach Figma link and component tokens before EOD Friday.
Casey: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/spotlight-bar-onboard  includes states + badge.
Diego: Decision summary: implement spotlight bar MVP (compact highlight + CTA) on first-run, collapses for returning users, route param for sample launch, emit analytics events, show checklist badge on project list when completed. Follow-up A/B: multi-card thumbnails. Noor to open branch; Mei to run mobile/a11y checks; Aria to publish event list.
Mei: I'll run a keyboard + screen-reader pass once PR is ready.
Noor: Branching now, will ping with PR link.
Diego: Thanks team  moving to sprint board and tagging as "next-sprint: onboarding-surface" :rocket:
